target_customer: Defense, aerospace and industrial buyers of magnesium, titanium, zirconium and hafnium
problem: The US depends on imports, mostly from China, for critical lightweight metals and its last primary magnesium producer failed.
business_model: Metal producer selling commodity and specialty metals

founders.name: Berkley Noble
founders.background_notes: Molten salt electrolysis expert; YC page says he holds a patent and built a US pilot magnesium electrolyzer

competitors.name: US Magnesium
competitors.what: Last US primary magnesium producer, Utah
competitors.traction_then: Plant shut in 2021 after failures; Chapter 11 in Sept 2025

competitors.name: Magrathea Metals
competitors.what: Oakland startup making magnesium from seawater brine
competitors.traction_then: pilot plant; $10M seed in 2023, Series A later

technical_complexity.rationale: Carbochlorination reactors and molten salt electrolysis at industrial scale are hard chemical engineering with capital intense pilots.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary reactor and process IP plus scarce domestic production position, but Chinese cost advantage is severe.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent has moved into this wedge; the leading US incumbent went bankrupt in 2025.

market_need_then: Domestic magnesium supply collapsed with US Magnesium's closure and bankruptcy, over 85% of magnesium comes from China per press, and federal critical minerals interest is high; Duranium disclosed lobbying for federal funding.

identity.visual_style: Periodic table style tiles per metal, industrial look
identity.voice_and_tone: Reshoring American industry, The Raw Material of Progress

branding.brand_signature: Periodic table tiles for each metal
branding.community_and_virality: Founder profile on yespress; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable sci fi flavoured name (also a Star Trek material, which may be intended or not, no source) but little press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Duranium is a Summer 2025 hardware heavy startup claiming a 15 tonne per year magnesium pilot in Oakland with titanium, hafnium and zirconium targeted for 2027 and 2028. Tailwinds are the collapse of US Magnesium and reshoring policy; risks are capital needs and Chinese pricing. A Tekedia Capital investment was announced in November 2025 but the size is unknown, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding conflict: PitchBook shows $5.2M early stage VC dated 2025-09-30 (total $5.7M, investors FundersClub and YC) while VCBacked shows $500K pre seed; both unverified aggregators so not recorded as rounds. Tekedia article gives no amount, round date is its publication date. Team size 12 on YC. Berkley Noble prior employers and education not found.
